Rashi on Yevamot 13b:10:1.hebrew: אין איסור - אשת אח חל על בתו של זה אצל אביה. הלכך, לא רמיא קמיה לייבומי, והוה כמאן דליתא, וכן באחות אשה ובכולן. והכי מפרשא מילתיה דרבא במסקנא דמילתא. ומיהו, הא דפריך ״תינח היכא דנשא כו'״ — לא ידע מילתיה דרבא, וסבר דרבא אאחות אשה וכיוצא בה לחודייהו קאי, שקורבתו ע"י קדושין:
Rashi on Yevamot 13b:10:1.english: A prohibition does not [take effect] - [The prohibition of] a brother’s wife does not take effect upon this [man’s] daughter with respect to her father; therefore, she is not cast before him for levirate marriage, and she is as if she does not exist. And so too regarding a wife’s sister, and regarding all of them. And this is how Rava’s statement is explained at the conclusion of the matter. However, as for that which [the Gemara] objects: “This works well where [the deceased brother] married, etc.” — [the questioner] did not know Rava’s statement, and thought that Rava refers only to a wife’s sister and [cases] similar to it, where the relationship [to him] is via betrothal.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:11:1.english: That the prohibition of a wife’s sister does not come and take effect upon the prohibition of a brother’s wife - And she is like an unrelated woman.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:13:1.hebrew: פשיטא - כיון דלב"ש זקוקות ליבם, פשיטא אם חלצו פסולות. ולב"ה, כיון דפטרי להו מזיקת יבום, אם חלצו כשרות לכהונה, דלאו חליצה היא:
Rashi on Yevamot 13b:13:1.english: It is obvious - Since according to Beit Shammai they are bound to the levir, it is obvious that if they performed chalitzah they are disqualified [from the priesthood]; and according to Beit Hillel, since they exempt them from the levirate bond, if they performed chalitzah they are fit for the priesthood, for it is not a [valid] chalitzah.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:14:1.english: [That] of Rabbi Yoḥanan - [This is taught] below (Yevamot 14b) in a baraita.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:14:2.hebrew: בואו ונתקן לצרות - העריות, שיהו חולצות. וכיון דבעו חליצה, חליצתה פוסלת אפי' לב"ה. קמ"ל, דב"ה אפי' תקנתא דרבנן לית להו בצרות דליחלצו:
Rashi on Yevamot 13b:14:2.english: Come and let us institute for rival wives - [The rival wives of] the forbidden relatives, that they should perform ḥalitza. And since they would require ḥalitza, her ḥalitza would disqualify [her from the priesthood], even according to Beit Hillel. [The mishna] teaches us that Beit Hillel do not even hold of a rabbinic enactment for rival wives that they should perform ḥalitza.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:15:1.hebrew: וב"ה פוסלין - דזונה היא, ופסולה לכהונה. אבל מתרומה דבי נשא לא מיפסלה בבעילת כרת, אלא בבעילת חלל ונתין וממזר ועובד כוכבים ועבד, בפרק אלמנה לכ"ג (לקמן יבמות סח:):
Rashi on Yevamot 13b:15:1.english: And Beit Hillel disqualify [them] - For she is a zonah and [is thus] disqualified from the priesthood. However, from the teruma of her father’s house she is not disqualified by an act of intercourse [punishable by] karet, but rather [only] by an act of intercourse with a ḥalal, a natin [Gibeonite], a mamzer, a gentile, or a slave, [as explained] in the chapter [entitled] “Almanah L’Kohen Gadol” (below, Yevamot 68b).

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:17:1.hebrew: לא תעשו אגודות אגודות - דנראה כנוהגין ב' תורות, כשקורין כפרים את המגילה ביום כניסה, ועיירות גדולות בי"ד, ומוקפין חומה בט"ו:
Rashi on Yevamot 13b:17:1.english: Do not form separate factions - For it appears as though they are observing two Torahs, when villages read the Megillah on the day of entry, large towns on the fourteenth, and [cities] surrounded by a wall on the fifteenth.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:18:1.english: If so, let the verse write: “You shall not cut” - For that implies the sense of cutting and wounding.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:18:2.english: And say that the entire [verse] comes for this [purpose] - That you not form factions.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:18:3.english: If so, let the verse write: “You shall not form factions” - Since it did not write tagodu, [which is] the sense of a faction.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:19:1.english: Have you not learned until now: 'A place where they were accustomed,' etc. - You should have given this answer.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:1:1.english: [If] they performed ḥalitza - The rival wives [performed ḥalitza] with the brothers.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:1:2.english: Beit Shammai disqualify [her] from the priesthood - For her ḥalitza is a [valid] ḥalitza.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:1:3.hebrew: וב"ה מכשירין - לפי שחליצתן שלא לצורך, והרי כחולצת מן הנכרי:
Rashi on Yevamot 13b:1:3.english: And Beit Hillel deem [them] fit - Because their ḥalitza is without need, and behold, [she] is like [a woman] who performs ḥalitza with an unrelated man.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:1:4.english: [If] they entered into levirate marriage - To the brothers.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:1:5.english: Beit Shammai deem [them] fit - [They deem] them [fit to marry] priests if they were widowed from their levirs.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:1:6.hebrew: ובית הלל פוסלין - שנבעלו לאסור להן, והנבעלה לפסול לה עשאה זונה, והזונה אסורה לכהונה:
Rashi on Yevamot 13b:1:6.english: And Beit Hillel disqualify [them] - For they had intercourse with [a man] forbidden to them; and [when] a woman has intercourse with [a man] disqualified to her, he renders her a *zonah*, and a *zonah* is forbidden to the priesthood.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:20:1.hebrew: אמינא לך אנא איסורא - דאסרי להו רבנן לבני ארביסר, דאי בעו למיקרא בחמיסר לא מצו, וכן בני ט"ו בי"ד, ודמיא לשתי תורות:
Rashi on Yevamot 13b:20:1.english: I speak to you of a prohibition - For the Sages prohibited [it to] the residents of the fourteenth, such that if they wish to read on the fifteenth they cannot, and similarly the residents of the fifteenth on the fourteenth; and it resembles two Torahs.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:20:2.hebrew: ואת אמרת לי מנהגא - דהתם לכ"ע שרי, ומיהו באתרא דאחמור לא ישנה את דרכו מפני המחלוקת:
Rashi on Yevamot 13b:20:2.english: And you speak to me of a custom - For there, it is permitted according to everyone; but nevertheless, in a place where they were stringent, one should not deviate from their practice on account of dispute.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:21:1.english: And we object: And there, is there no prohibition? - [This is said] in astonishment.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:21:2.hebrew: והא קתני התם בלילה - בליל בדיקת חמץ, ב"ש אוסרים וב"ה מתירים לעשות מלאכה, ואיכא דעבדי כב"ה ואיכא דעבדי כבית שמאי — והרי כאן אגודות:
Rashi on Yevamot 13b:21:2.english: And doesn’t [the mishna] teach there: “At night” - On the night of the search for chametz, Beit Shammai prohibit and Beit Hillel permit performing work, and there are those who act according to Beit Hillel and there are those who act according to Beit Shammai — and behold, there are factions here.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:22:1.hebrew: א"ל התם - לא דמי לשתי תורות, דהרואה את זה שאין עושה מלאכה אומר דאין לו מה לעשות:
Rashi on Yevamot 13b:22:1.english: He said to him: There - It is not similar to [the appearance of] two Torahs, for one who sees this [person] who is not performing work says that he has nothing to do.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:2:1.hebrew: לא נמנעו כו' - אע"פ שבני הצרה שנתייבמו כב"ש ממזרים [הם לב"ה] — שהרי באיסור אשת אח היא עליהם, ואשת אח בכרת, ובני עריות שהן חייבי כריתות ממזרים הם, כדאמרינן בפירקין — אפ"ה, לא נמנעו ב"ה מלישא נשים מב"ש, לפי שהיו מודיעים להם אותן הבאות מן הצרות, ופורשים:
Rashi on Yevamot 13b:2:1.english: They did not refrain, etc. - Even though the children of the rival wives who were taken in levirate marriage according to Beit Shammai are mamzerim [according to Beit Hillel] — for she remains [forbidden] to them under the prohibition of a brother's wife, and [intercourse with] a brother's wife is [punishable by] excision, and the offspring of forbidden unions that are liable to excision are mamzerim, as we say in our chapter — even so, Beit Hillel did not refrain from marrying women from Beit Shammai, because they [Beit Shammai] would inform them of those [women] who were descended from the rival wives, and they [Beit Hillel] would separate [from them].

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:2:2.english: These upon those - These would lend their vessels to those.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:3:1.hebrew: לא תהיה אשת המת החוצה - החיצונה, שהיא נכרית ליבם, לא תהיה לזר:
Rashi on Yevamot 13b:3:1.english: The wife of the deceased shall not be [married] outside - The outer [wife], who is unrelated to the yavam, shall not be [married] to a stranger.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:3:2.english: By inference that there is an inside [wife] - Together with her, [there is] a relative of the yavam.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:4:1.hebrew: שאין קידושין תופסין ביבמה - יבמה שלא חלצה — מנין, אם נתקדשה לשוק, שאין קדושין תופסין, אע"ג דחייבי לאוין בעלמא תפסי בהו קידושין:
Rashi on Yevamot 13b:4:1.english: That betrothal is not effective in [the case of] a yevama - [Regarding] a yevama who did not perform ḥalitza — from where [is it derived that] if she was betrothed to an outsider, betrothal is not effective, even though generally with those who are subject to negative prohibitions, betrothal is effective with them?

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:4:2.english: The verse states, etc.: There shall not be in her [case] becoming [married] - They [the betrothal] do not take effect.

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:5:1.english: It is written “outside” - Which implies an external [woman].

Rashi on Yevamot 13b:8:1.hebrew: לרבות ארוסה - שאם נתארמלה מן האירוסין, צריכה ליבם כנשואה. וחוצה משמע חיצונה, שלא נתקרבה עדיין לביאה:
Rashi on Yevamot 13b:8:1.english: To include a betrothed woman - That if she was widowed from betrothal, she requires levirate marriage like a married woman. And “outside” implies one who is outside, who has not yet drawn close to cohabitation.

Tosafot on Yevamot 13b:11:1.hebrew: דלא אתי איסור אחות אשה וחייל אאיסור אשת אח - וא"ת: כיון דאיסור אחות אשה לא חייל, תתייבם ערוה גופה! וי"ל: דאיסור אחות אשה מיתלא תלי וקאי — אי פקע איסור אשת אח, אתי וחייל; הלכך, לא פקע:
Tosafot on Yevamot 13b:11:1.english: That the prohibition of a wife’s sister does not come and take effect upon the prohibition of a brother’s wife - And if you say: Since the prohibition of a wife’s sister does not take effect, let the forbidden relative herself undergo levirate marriage! And one can say: The prohibition of a wife’s sister stands in suspense — if the prohibition of a brother’s wife were to lapse, [the prohibition of a wife’s sister] would come and take effect; therefore, [the prohibition of a brother’s wife] does not lapse.

Tosafot on Yevamot 13b:13:1.hebrew: בית הלל פוסלים - פי' בקונטרס: מכהונה, ולא מתרומה. וא"א לומר כן, דמחייבי כריתות זונה היא, כדאמרינן בהחולץ (לקמן יבמות מד:) גבי הנושא את חלוצתו; וזונה אסורה בתרומה, כמו שנפרש שם בע"ה (ד"ה הכא). ורש"י עצמו חזר בסוף פירקא (דף טו: ד"ה היא עצמה), גבי: מה לאלמנה שכן היא עצמה מתחללת:
Tosafot on Yevamot 13b:13:1.english: "Beit Hillel disqualify" - The Kuntres explained: [They are disqualified] from [marrying into] the priesthood, but not from [eating] teruma. And it is impossible to say so, for [by having relations with one] liable to excision [karet], she becomes a zona, as we say in [the chapter] HaḤoletz (below, 44b) regarding one who marries his ḥalutza; and a zona is forbidden to [eat] teruma, as we will explain there, with God's help (s.v. Hakha). And Rashi himself retracted at the end of the chapter (15b, s.v. Hi atzmah), regarding: "What [is unique] about a widow, in that she herself becomes profaned?"

Tosafot on Yevamot 13b:17:1.hebrew: דאמר רחמנא לא תעשו חבורה על מת - והא דאמרינן בסוף פרק ד' מיתות (סנהדרין דף סח. ושם) גבי ר"ע, שהיה מכה עצמו על ר"א שנפטר, עד שהיה דמו שותת לארץ — ואומר רבינו יצחק, דאיכא למימר דדרך שריטה אסר רחמנא דוקא; א"נ: אתורה היה מצטער, כדאמרינן התם: "הרבה מעות יש לי ואין שולחני" כו':
Tosafot on Yevamot 13b:17:1.english: "As the Merciful One said: Do not make a wound over the dead" - And as for that which we say at the end of the chapter [entitled] Arba Mitot (Sanhedrin 68a, and there) regarding Rabbi Akiva, who was striking himself over Rabbi Eliezer who passed away until his blood was flowing to the ground — Rabbeinu Yitzchak says that it can be said that the Merciful One forbade specifically in the manner of scratching. Alternatively, he was grieving over the Torah, as we say there: "I have many coins, but I have no money changer..." etc.

Tosafot on Yevamot 13b:3:1.hebrew: מאי טעמא דב"ש - וא"ת: ומאי קבעי ליה? דלמא מוקמי לצרור לכדר"ש (לעיל יבמות דף ח:), ועליה לכדרבי? ואומר רבינו יצחק: משום דמסתברא ליה לדרוש לצרור לענין צרות, אי לאו דשמעיה בשום דוכתא דשריא. וא"ת: אכתי, כי דרשי נמי חוצה מכלל דאיכא פנימית, נדרוש מלצרור למיסר צרה שלא במקום מצוה! וי"ל: דליכא למדרש הכי, דהא כתיב לגלות ערותה — דחדא; ולמקום מצוה לא איצטריך, דמחוצה נפקא — אלא לשלא במקום מצוה:
Tosafot on Yevamot 13b:3:1.english: What is the reason of Beit Shammai - And if you say: What is [the Gemara] asking? Perhaps they establish "to be a rival" [litzror] in accordance with [the teaching of] Rabbi Shimon (above, Yevamot 8b), and "upon her" [aleha] in accordance with [the teaching of] Rabbi! And Rabbeinu Yitzchak says: Because it was logical to [the Gemara] to expound "to be a rival" [litzror] regarding rival wives [tzarot], were it not that it had heard somewhere that they are permitted. And if you say: Still, even when they also expound "outside" [hachutzah] — by inference that there is an inside [relative wife] — let us expound from "to be a rival" [litzror] to prohibit a rival wife outside the place of a mitzvah! And it can be answered: One cannot expound this way, for behold, it is written: "to uncover her nakedness" (Leviticus 18:18), which indicates one [woman]; and for the place of a mitzvah it was not needed, as that is derived from "outside"; rather, [it must refer] to outside the place of a mitzvah.

Tosafot on Yevamot 13b:4:1.hebrew: לכדרב יהודה אמר רב כו' - ה"נ המ"ל: לכדשמואל, דפליג עליה דרב בהאשה רבה (לקמן יבמות דף צב: ושם), ומוקי קרא דללאו הוא דאתא:
Tosafot on Yevamot 13b:4:1.english: "For that which Rav Yehuda said that Rav said, etc." - Here too, [the Gemara] could have said: For that of Shmuel, who disagrees with Rav in [the chapter] "HaIsha Rabbah" (below, Yevamot 92b and there), and establishes that the verse comes for a negative prohibition.

Tosafot on Yevamot 13b:5:1.hebrew: כיון דכתיב חוצה כמאן דכתיב לחוץ דמי - ואע"ג דכתיב נמי ה"א בתחלה, דכתיב החוצה — היינו נמי אל החוץ, כמו המדברה (שמות ד), דהוי אל המדבר:
Tosafot on Yevamot 13b:5:1.english: Since it is written “outside,” it is considered as though it is written: To the outside - And even though a heh is also written at the beginning, as it is written: “hachutzah” — this too means “to the outside,” like “hamidbarah” (Exodus 4), which means “to the wilderness.”

Tosafot on Yevamot 13b:8:1.hebrew: לרבות את הארוסה - אר"י: דאיצטריך לרבויי ארוסה, משום דכתיב "בית אחיו", ובפ"ק דיומא (דף יג.) משמע ד"בית" נשואה משמע:
Tosafot on Yevamot 13b:8:1.english: "To include a betrothed woman" - The Ri explains that it was necessary to include a betrothed woman because it is written: "his brother's house" [Deuteronomy 25:9], and in the first chapter of Yoma (13a) it implies that "house" means a married woman.
